supersession_reason: Contextual accents made the initial candidates read as state labels instead of dedicated facial expressions.
purpose: Core special-function source art only; face pose is the primary state signal. This is not a runtime resource, CRIG, profile, firmware binding, or panel claim.
identity_invariants: same V9 open-eye silhouette, pupil fills, one primary highlight and one small sparkle per eye
same eye pair scale, spacing, baseline and nose anchor as the locked V9 reference
no new eye shape, eyelash, iris color, text, UI panel, battery icon, microphone icon or menu icon
state distinction comes first from brows, mouth, cheek relationship and legal highlight pose
a contextual accent is optional, secondary and must be removable without losing the facial-state reading
monochrome black ink on a clean white background with every ink component inside a 200x200 export-safe face area

poses.semantic: A visibly thoughtful, composed face: inner brow ends draw gently toward focus, outer brow ends stay soft, the mouth tucks into a compact asymmetric thinking curve, and cheek dots sit calm and close. It must read as thinking even with no accent.
poses.choreography_intent: Daily shifts a legal highlight first, brows settle into thought, the compact mouth completes the pose, and exit reverses to Daily through the same facial components only.

poses.semantic: A visibly attentive listening face: brows narrow gently toward the center without anger, the mouth becomes a small calm closed focus mark, and cheek dots lift by a subtle legal relationship. It must read as attention even with no ripple or microphone symbol.
poses.choreography_intent: Entry shifts legal highlights, then brows and mouth; active state performs a bounded highlight/brow breathe; stop or cancel reverses through the same facial components.

poses.semantic: A visibly restful replenishing face: brows relax upward and outward, the mouth becomes a small rounded content smile, and cheeks feel gently buoyant. It must read as calm restoration even with no battery, plug, bolt, dot or breathing mark.
poses.choreography_intent: Entry softens legal highlights and brows, the active state performs a slow bounded highlight/brow breathe, and unplugging reverses to Daily through the same facial components.

required_followup: generate one source image per pose using the locked V9 reference
write generated-source hashes and prompt lineage before any crop or export
reject a source if the special state is readable only through an accessory
extract only source components, reassemble deterministic 200x200 PBM frames and verify identity geometry
run browser/target component-plan parity and canonical owner-art review
keep runtime_resource_activated false until the physical White and Black gates pass
